title: Eternal Youth
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|q_where = id="eternal_youth_keytone2692"}}

'''Eternal Youth''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] which causes [[energy shield]] recharge to apply to [[life]], but halves your life [[regeneration]] and life [[leech]].

==Mechanics==
Your life recharge rate is dependent on your total life pool, not your [[energy shield]] pool.

As with energy shield, losing life to [[damage]] will interrupt the recharge. Taking damage to energy shield or mana will not interrupt life recharge. Reserving life with {{il|Dissolution of the Flesh}} will interrupt recharge if the reservation lowers current life; reservation of ''missing'' life does not interrupt. 

Modifiers that prevent energy shield recharge, such as {{psl|Ghost Reaver}} and {{il|Shavronne's Revelation}}, do not prevent life recharge.

Modifiers to energy shield recharge, such as {{C|mod|faster start of energy shield recharge}} and {{C|mod|increased energy shield recharge rate}}, apply to life recharge instead. {{psl|id=wicked_ward_keystone2342}} prevents life recharge from being interrupted.

The less Life Regeneration Rate mod on the keystone does not lower energy shield regeneration when {{psl|Zealot's Oath}} keystone is allocated.

==Location==
Eternal Youth is located on the west side of the tree, on the intersection between the Scion, Marauder, and Templar paths.

This keystone can also be obtained from the tree by using a [[legacy variant|legacy]] {{il|Glorious Vanity}} jewel with modifier {{c|mod|Bathed in the blood of (100–8000) sacrificed in the name of '''Zerphi'''}}. The jewel will conquer any keystones within the radius (size: 1500) of the jewel.
